current_bottleneck: The real MPC public depth has only a fixed-record TLS reader; a browser cannot retrieve it as an HTTP resource.
causal_hypothesis: An isolated HTTP adapter using maintained HTTP parsing and the existing pinned TLS verifier can return exactly the finalized aggregate book without gaining corporate keys, private journals or order access.
single_intended_change: Add read-only GET /v1/book with optional minimum_sequence, no cache, no financial methods, and fail-closed generic errors. Leave actual four-order settlement scenario and trust assumptions unchanged.
most_likely_prediction_error: Adapter error handling, snapshot expiry or orchestration may return stale data, hide an upstream outage, or fail to preserve exact pre/post-settlement snapshot semantics.
rejection_rules: missing real upstream stop or market crash
any original native depth financial/finality gate failure
HTTP adapter mounts corporate secret or market private journal
promotion_rules: smoke_only only after actual complete native scenario; not browser, financial API, public-internet availability or product acceptance
command: make remote-native-http-e2e REMOTE_TEST_HOST=softbank-l40s REMOTE_TEST_SSH_OPTIONS='-o BatchMode=yes -o ProxyJump=none'
